The mock examination uses the same rules, question structure, and 50-minute duration as the midterm. Attempt it under examination conditions and record your answers on paper.

- [Question paper (PDF)](midterm-mock.pdf)
- [Q2 · van der Waals equation (editable notebook)](../wasm-local/midterm_mock_q2.html){target="_blank"}
- [Q3 · Growth-rate fitting (editable notebook)](../wasm-local/midterm_mock_q3.html){target="_blank"}

Each notebook contains the given constants or data and placeholders for the labelled parts. Use **Save** or Ctrl+S / Cmd+S to download your edited notebook, as you will during the midterm.
